label: WATCH
rationale: Scorecard 68/100 (Starter / Watch), with a business-quality subtotal of 57/75 — the lowest of the four names analysed in this harness (TSM 66, NVDA 62, 005930 59). The operating economics are genuinely excellent. Capex is 1.0% of revenue, free cash flow margin 42.1%, semiconductor operating margin expanding 55.7% to 61.8%, infrastructure software at a 78.7% margin, and Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue of $16.7B grew 221% YoY with Q4 guided to $21.7B. FY2026 revenue lands near $105.9B, up 65.8%. low_quality_growth and incremental_roic_collapse both read PASS. Three things hold this at WATCH rather than STARTER. FIRST AND DECISIVE, concentration: one distributor customer went from 29% to 42% of TOTAL revenue in a single year, top five to 45%, distributors to 56%. That is the most extreme concentration in this harness — worse than NVDA's 22% and TSM's 19% — and it is amplified by roughly $47.1B of net debt, the only materially levered balance sheet of the four. Losing or halving one relationship at 42% of revenue is a business-model event, not a margin event. SECOND, the per-share test fails. Share count is RISING — 4,139M to 4,758M — uniquely among these names, and in H1 FY2026 it rose 17M DESPITE $8,450M of buybacks, because SBC of $4,268M (10.3% of revenue) issued more stock than repurchases retired. The strategy's core metric is FCF per share, and per-share compounding is being leaked. In fairness most of the multi-year increase was VMware acquisition currency, which is why persistent_dilution is INVESTIGATE at MEDIUM rather than HIGH. THIRD, valuation. At $357.16 the multiple is roughly 38x ESTIMATED FY2026 GAAP earnings — the highest of the four — and 29x non-GAAP. Valuation is assessed on GAAP because roughly half the non-GAAP add-back is SBC, which is demonstrably a real cost given the rising share count. Probability-weighted five-year return is only about +9.6% total (1.8% annualised), against NVDA's +21.2% and TSM's +37.9%. The expectation gap is POSITIVE but the thinnest of the four, and unlike TSM's unresearchable geopolitical gate, AVGO's primary gate is a DISCLOSURE QUESTION WITH A DEFINITE ANSWER — identify the 42% customer and establish whether the XPU programmes are contracted multi-year. When a gate can be resolved by waiting one or two quarters and the expected return does not compensate for acting early, the disciplined call is to wait. Band NONE.
increase_evidence: PRIMARY, and it is answerable: identification of the 42% distributor and the end customers behind it, plus confirmation that the underlying XPU programmes are contracted multi-year rather than re-bid per generation. Below roughly 30% single-customer concentration, or with multi-year contracts confirmed, this moves toward STARTER.
Buybacks sized to at least offset SBC issuance, so that share count actually falls over four consecutive quarters.
Q3 and Q4 FY2026 GAAP actuals confirming the estimated $45B FY2026 GAAP net income, replacing the analyst's own build.
Infrastructure software re-accelerating above roughly 10%, restoring the second engine.
The tax footnote explaining the FY2025 $397M benefit and confirming it is non-recurring.
Semiconductor operating margin holding above 60% through the next XPU generation transition, evidencing that sockets are being retained rather than re-won on price.
Price weakness that widens the gap WITHOUT deterioration in the above. Per policy/position-sizing.yaml price decline alone is never sufficient.
reduce_or_exit_evidence: Single-customer concentration rising above roughly 45%, or any indication the 42% customer is in-sourcing or dual-sourcing its XPU programme.
Share count continuing to rise through the AI revenue peak — a company cannot compound FCF per share while issuing net new stock at the top of its cycle.
Semiconductor operating margin falling below roughly 55%, indicating XPU sockets are being defended on price.
Infrastructure software declining rather than merely decelerating, which would remove the high-margin floor under the bear case.
A goodwill impairment, or a sustained market capitalisation below net book value — the 10-K names this as an impairment indicator against $130,074M of goodwill and intangibles.
A hyperscaler capex guidance cut, given that the demand behind the concentration is AI capex funded from balance sheet rather than operating cash flow.
Net debt rising materially from roughly $47.1B to fund acquisitions rather than being reduced.
